market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Crypto cycles post-halving typically peak 12–18 months later, then enter a bear market. The window Nov 2025–Dec 2026 coincides with the likely bear phase. In previous cycles, Solana drew down >90% from all-time highs, making a touch of $20 (an ~85–90% drop from typical mid-2025 prices) historically plausible. The market's 9.5% implied probability appears too low for this scenario.
evidence_points: Bitcoin halving 2024 → historical peak late 2025 → bear market 2026
Solana dropped ~97% from ATH in the last cycle (Nov 2021–Nov 2022), hitting ~$8
Time window covers the most likely period for a severe correction after the expected bull peak
